items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: especially Bert. Bert was a very fine man who produced many of those, uh, LPs, Pop LPs... I didn’t like the idea because I wanted to do a Jazz record.

ctx.x: So who was it that wanted you to do pop?

Producers, they have professional producers there, you know, Mike Bernicker. They explain it to me, especially Bert. Bert was a very fine man who produced many of those, uh, LPs, Pop LPs, you know, Freddie Hubbard used to do that type of thing. Many of them, Hubert Laws… I didn’t like the idea because I wanted to do a Jazz record. Then Bruce Lundvall, he was the President in those days, he save my life, “No, no. He don’t want to do that. He want to do a Jazz record first.” And then in those days, I have my first…
